_protocol_note: Trinity section 4.1: max 4096 generated tokens per LLM, minimal reasoning effort, max 5 coordination turns. Repetitions=3 matches the paper's 3 seeds used for per-question-best labels (Appendix A.2.1).

screening.note: Appendix A.6 needs E(D, M) for EVERY candidate agent on EVERY candidate dataset before subsets can be enumerated. Keep this small: it is paid once per candidate agent.

pilot.note: 60 tasks x 7 agents x 3 repetitions = 1260 calls. Sized so that even if every call saturates max_tokens the run stays under a $2.50 budget; the realistic figure is nearer $0.60.

_source_groups.note: Mirrors Trinity: train in-distribution, measure zero-shot transfer on held-out. Held-out sources are forced into the test split and never appear in train or validation.
